scenarios.reasoning: The agent correctly identified the root cause: HotReload test files using .NET Core-only APIs (System.Runtime.Loader) being compiled unconditionally for net472, causing FS0039 errors that cascade into ~165 FS0072 type inference failures. The analysis is well-structured with a clear summary table and actionable fix suggestions. The investigation was somewhat inefficient (61 tool calls, many failed file reads due to temp file issues), but the final conclusion is accurate and well-presented. The only notable gap is not clearly distinguishing the net10.0-specific type mismatch errors as a separate category from the net472 cascade.
scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem
